aboutText: Concrete CC has been serving Truganina and the greater Melbourne area for over a decade, providing top-notch floor repair, paving, and concreting services. Our team of professionals is dedicated to delivering high-quality results with a focus on customer satisfaction. We specialise in industrial floor upgrading and refurbishments, ensuring durable and aesthetically pleasing solutions for all your flooring needs.
servicesText: From floor repairs and paving to asphalt and concreting, Concrete CC offers a comprehensive range of services for both residential and commercial clients. We pride ourselves on using the latest techniques and materials to ensure long-lasting results.

services.title: Floor Repair & Refurbishments
services.desc: We restore damaged floors to their original glory with expert repair and refurbishment services, ensuring a smooth and durable finish.

services.title: Floor Paving
services.desc: Durable and eco-friendly paving solutions for driveways, pathways, and outdoor areas, perfect for homes and businesses.

services.title: Asphalt Services
services.desc: Professional asphalt installation and repair for roads, car parks, and surfaces, providing a robust and weather-resistant option.

services.title: Concreting
services.desc: High-quality concreting for slabs, foundations, and structures, tailored to meet your specific project requirements.

services.title: Industrial Floor Upgrading
services.desc: Specialised in upgrading and refurbishing industrial floors to enhance durability and functionality for heavy use.

services.title: Concrete Driveways
services.desc: Custom concrete driveway solutions that combine aesthetics with longevity, adding value to your property.
